reviews.reviewerId: scene-closure execution owner (Claude Opus 5 main session, openclinxr-c2)
reviews.observations: Reran every doneWhen command in the integrated main checkout rather than accepting the implementer report: mpfb record plus graft 11/11, bound-walk foot plant 12/12, the named behavior test 10/10, assert-contract-live 1 contract live, verifier suite 20/20, and this card own suites 69/69. Broad regression across every landed card in the package 299/299, typecheck:relaxed 0 errors, knip clean. Ran an own destructive probe of the integration edit rather than only the implementer two-sided probe: re-adding openclinxr_retarget_cmu_02_01_walk to the physician provenance record fails clause (4) of apps/ui-xr/src/the-shipped-humanoids-hash-to-their-provenance.test.ts and nothing else, so the CMU-absence half of that clause is a real gate and not decoration. Accepted the licence resolution on its evidence: CMU is CONDITIONAL under ledger rows 04 and 08 and these GLBs are downloadable from Vite public directory, so the derived clip is redistribution of converted data; the replacement is CC0 VERIFIED from the clone own LICENSE-CC0.MD with the CarnegieMellonAnimations subtree excluded by name. Accepted the foot-plant regression as recorded rather than softened: Walk_Formal slides about 3x the CMU clip and the existing under-0.2 threshold was not weakened, the regression is asserted as a fact and declared in limits.unresolvedDefects. Made three owner repairs the gates caught, all in this card own new files, and none of them weakened a gate: a TS2305 on a type imported from a package root where it is not re-exported, fixed at the declaring module rather than by adding a root export that would have moved an exact-equality rootEntrypointExports ceiling; sixteen noNonNullAssertion and two noShadow findings, each replaced with a guard that throws after biome own --unsafe autofix was measured to change behaviour for the worse in five places; and an unused-file failure on extract-library-clip.ts, which had landed with no importer at all. That last one is the correct-but-inert class and was closed by giving the tool a caller and a gate rather than by declaring it an entry point. Corrected the same owner defect for the third time in this package: the brief never named the owner evidence registry, so the implementer created its own at /Volumes/files/src/.openclinxr-sc-evidence; its artifacts were migrated byte-unchanged into the owner store and this report rebound to the owner registry hash.

unresolvedDefects: FOOT-PLANT REGRESSION, measured not assumed: the CC0 Walk_Formal replacement plants its feet materially worse than the CMU clip it replaces. Measured by the identical procedure on the same rig, toe1-1.L slides 0.2487 of the ground covered (18 contact frames) against the CMU clip's 0.0297 (54 frames), and toe1-1.R 0.2704 against 0.0816. The licence question forced the replacement; the plant did not improve with it, and SC-00's rubric and SC-05's arrival evidence must be calibrated against these numbers rather than the retired clip's.

SPEED MISMATCH: the replacement's stance-derived ground speed is 0.676 m/s against CLINICIAN_WALK_SPEED_MPS of 1.1, a ratio of 0.615. The runtime must either time-scale the clip by about 1.63 or lower the executor's constant; SC-05 owns that decision.

Same root cause as the first Walk_Formal bind. Not this card's asset; recorded so it is not rediscovered.
